newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Renong to lead rail privatisation.
newsitem.headline: Renong to lead rail privatisation.

text.p: Malaysian infrastructure developer Renong Bhd will lead a consortium of companies in the privatisation of the country's railway network, according to a statement released by Bolton Properties Bhd.

Renong will acquire a 50 percent stake in the Keretapi Tanah Melayu Bhd (KTMB) project while Diversified Resources Bhd (DRB) and Bolton will take up 30 percent and 20 percent respectively, a statement from Bolton sent to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Tuesday said.
DRB is involved in assembling and distributing private and commercial motor vehicles. Bolton is engaged in property development and related activities.

A research report by HLG Securities on Wednesday said that interest in KTMB "lies mainly in its landbank of 31,250 acres which was valued by the Treasury in 1986 at one billion ringgit." The report warns, however, that "rail operations will sap the bulk of profits".
HLG noted that the method of funding the railway purchase remains unknown, but that any acquisition of the operation will not be cheap given estimated asset values of around two billion ringgit.

Jupiter Securities said in a research note on Wednesday: "Earnings per share may not be coming in too soon as this will take at least 3-5 years to pan out. Impact per share will be heftiest on Bolton Properties as its condo and complex expertise will be put to full use on very prime land."
